Callout.Name: Bull Loose
Callout.Message: Bull escaped into a public footpath.
Callout.Advisory: Animal agitated, walkers in the area.

Script.Line: He went through the gate when the post van came up. He hates that van.
He is not vicious. He is a bull, and he is out on a footpath.
If anybody runs, that is when it goes wrong. Tell people not to run.

Lines.Approach: It is on the footpath and there are walkers up there. Keep everybody back and wait for the owner.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
